title: Two habits the compiler accepted and did nothing with are warned about where they are written: a `/** … */` block above a declaration, and `{Class::…}` inside a markup literal
scope:
two advisory diagnostics, `W1011` and `W1012`, and the reference headings that make
`///` and the `<?= … ?>` hole reachable through `nvs agent find`. What a doc comment is, and
what a markup literal's holes admit, are unchanged and stay with [0137](0137.md) and
[0202](0202.md).
